_comment: Copy to users.json and replace every key. Prefer 'api_key_hashes' (sha256 hex of the key) over plaintext 'api_keys'. Generate a key: python -c "import secrets;print('shield_'+secrets.token_urlsafe(32))" ; hash it: python -c "import hashlib,sys;print(hashlib.sha256(sys.argv[1].encode()).hexdigest())" <key>
